full_judgment:
2. Facts leading to filing of this civil petition for leave to appeal in short are that the present respondents No. 1 and 2 as plain-tiffs instituted Title Suit No. 271 of 2006 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Singair, Manikgonj, for declaration of their title, on the basis of purchase of the suit land described in the schedule to the plaint and also for declaration that RS record in respect of the said land is wrong. Subsequently the said suit being transferred to the Court of Assistant Judge, Harirampur, Manikganj, renumbered as Title Suit No. 1.96 of 2007. It is stated that 0.26 acre of land of C.S. Khatian No. 90 corresponding to C.S. plot No. under mouja Binodpur Borokhando, Singair, Manikgonj originally belonged Lc Ghetu Pramanik in 8(eight) annas shares, Hcrinhok- a Pramanik in 4 annas share and Tenu Praman 1A in share; that while in possession Ghetu Pramanik died leaving behind 3 sons namely, Juran, Hridoy and Kurani who inherited the same; that thereafter Hridoy plod leaving behind one son, Nitai; and Kurani died leaving behind one daughter, Monisha; that subsequently, pursuant to amicable settlement between the parties, Juran became the owner of .15 acre of land and Nitai and Monisha together became the owners of .11 acre of land; that Juran transferred his .15 acre of land to Haldar Mondal who died leaving behind two sons, namely, Kutu Mondal and Dudu Mondal and as such they became the owners of .15 acre of land; that subsequently, said Kutu. Mondal and Dudu Mondal transferred their 0.15 acre of land in favour of one Gafur and handed over possession of the same who in his turn transferred the same in favour of the plaintiffs and defendant No. 1 vide kabala No. 4111. dated 09.10.1986 in equal share; that Nitai and Monisha also transferred 0.10 out of 0.11 acre of land in favour of plaintiff No.1 vide kabala No. 11990 dated 18.11.1972 and subsequently on 01.12.1972 they also transferred the rest 0.01 acre of land in favour of plaintiff No.1 by unregistered document as the value of the same was below Tk.100.00 but the Plaintiffs are owning and possessing the said 0.10 acre from Gafur and 0.11 acre from Nitai and Monisha total 0.21 acre of land by purchase; that in the end of Ashaar, 1413 B.S. when the plaintiffs went to pay rents they came to know that out of 0.15 acre of land purchased from Gafur only 0.08 acre of land has been recorded in their names in RS Khatian No. 351 in place of 0.10 and .10 acre of land has been recorded in the name of defendant No.1, Abdul Ali, in R.S. Khatian No. 516 in place of 0.05 acre of land and out of 0.11 acre of land purchased from Nitai and Monisha only 0.08 acre of land has been recorded in the name of Plaintiff No.1 Jinnot Ali; hence the suit. 

 3. Defendant No. 2 contested the suit, by filing written statement, contending, inter alia, that, the suit land along with other lands measuring 0.26 acre originally belonged to Ghetu Pramanik in 8 annas share, Horibhokta Pramanik in 4 annas share and Tenu Pramanik in 4 annas share; that on the basis of amicable partition, Ghetu Pramanik became the owner of 0.26 acre of land and as such while possessing the same, Ghetu Pramanik died leaving behind three sons namely Juran, Hridoy and Kurani as his heirs; thereafter Hridoy died leaving behind his son Nitai and Kurani died leaving behind his daughter Monisha; that Juran Mondal by amicable partition had been possessing the entire 0.26 acre of land out of which he transferred 0,13 acre along with 0.38 acre in RS Plot no. 219, 0.6 'A acre in RS Plot No. 185 and 0.38k acre in RS Plot No. 186 of Binodpur Boroldwido mouza in total .96 acre of land to Haider Mondal by registered kabala dated 23.02.1956; that Haider Mondal died leaving behind two sons namely, Kutu Mondal and Dudu Mondal and they transferred .15 acre, of the suit land along with acre out of .37 acre of land in SA Plot No. 185 and 0.45½ acre out of 0.88 acre of land in SA Plot No. 186, totalling .70 acre of land to defendant No.2; that the said defendant No.2 although purchased 0.15 acre of the suit land but he possessed the entire 0.26 acre of the suit land; that thereafter the defendant no.2 on 09.10.1986 transferred 0.15 acre; of land out of the suit land along with .11¼ acre of land from Plots no. 185 and 186 in total .26¼ acre of land to the plaintiffs and the defendant No.1; that the defendant no.1 obtained 0.10 acre of land in the western part of the suit land; that pursuant to amicable settlement RS record has been prepared and accordingly he is possessing the same upon erecting houses thereon; that the defendant No.2 is the owner and possessor of 0.08 acre of land situated in the eastern side adjacent to the 0.10 acre of land of the defendant No.1 on the western side which has been recorded in the RS record in his name; that on the basis of settlement the plaintiffs are possessing 0.08 acre on the eastern side of the suit land along with 0.09 acre of land in SA Plot No. 185 in total .17 acre of land which has been recorded in his name; that the RS record has not been prepared in the name of the defendant no.2; that the plain-tiff no.1 fraudulently got .44 acre of land of defendant no.2 in Plot no. 186 recorded in his name in RS Khatian No. 517, Plots No. 345 and 346 and erected some houses in some portion of the same forcibly and dispossessed the defendants; that the plaintiff no.1 expressed about the purchase of .10 acre of land from Nitai and Monisha on 18.11.1972 but had no possession over the same; that Ni tai Left for India during Pakistan regime; that the plaintiffs on false personation fraudulently created the deed by which no title vested upon him and, as such, the suit is not maintainable; hence the suit should be dismissed.
